import requests

url = "https://example.com/big.bin"
chunk_size = 8192

with requests.get(url, stream=True, timeout=30) as response:
    response.raise_for_status()
    with open("big.bin", "wb") as f:
        for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
            if chunk:
                f.write(chunk)
